statement: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 establishes hazardous-energy control requirements for covered general-industry servicing and maintenance where unexpected energization, startup, or release of stored energy could injure workers, while expressly excluding agriculture employment from this standard's scope.

review.rationale: Drafted from reviewed OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 and cross-checked against the current OSHA standard on September 15, 2026. The explicit agriculture exclusion is retained to prevent the course from presenting this general-industry standard as universally applicable to every cultivation operation.
review.notes: Human occupational-safety/legal-scope review is required before promotion. Facility classification and other applicable standards must be determined separately.

sourceContext.contextTitle: Know when operator work becomes servicing
